===== BEGIN H84_design.txt =====
H84 targeted field-fill transaction, not full lifetime proof.
Opened kF search.hpp533-541, current corrected_eval invalid-bit8 producer, and original r15d material_key1243 onward. Actual producer writes corr_mat_idx narrowed uint16 and publishes validbit8. Reference counts square-array pieces independently of bitboard material_key; compares mathematical masked size_t index with stored field and full post corr_valid against pre|8. One use per reached cache-miss fill, not valid-cache consumers. Colour and pre other-valid-bits partitions. WRONG18 White flips private expected validbit8; actual untouched.
H33/H35 already cover move/null propagation; H36 both consumers. New partial evidence addresses field initialization/storage/validity publication, not resets, every invalidation, stale valid lifetime, concurrency, or independent absolute Board correctness. No second actual evaluation/table write/counterhook.

===== END H84_design.txt =====

===== BEGIN H17_design.txt =====
H17 default BADCAP_PREFIX=1 stores SEE-rejected captures in consumed prefix slots of moves_, rather than old separate bad_captures_ array. One use per actual BadCaptures return. A diagnostic separate vector appends full Move at the existing SEE rejection event after the existing TT skip; no second SEE call or alternate classification. Compare actual returned full Move fields/order with shadow slot and stable bad_count_ with shadow length. bad_index_ advances once on return; bad_count_ only advances on buffering and is not decremented on reads.
Each MovePicker starts with an empty shadow and bad_count/index0; staged GoodCaptures generation is entered once, then transitions through killers/counter/quiets and finally BadCaptures. TT capture is skipped before rejection/buffering in both actual and reference. Shadow is untouched by quiet generation/sorting, allowing reached prefix overwrite to be detected. Abort/early-cutoff unconsumed buffered suffix is not observed; no terminal exhaustion event is counted.
White/Black, first/later return, promotion/nonpromotion each partition uses. Buffered writes are separately tallied, not matching uses or node counts. WRONG18 flips bit0 only in private expected Move.flags on White-to-move returns; actual Move/storage/order unchanged. Full field comparison includes flags, so the fault always changes compared data even if operator== ignores some flags.
Reference shares actual SEE acceptance and original captured Move inputs, so it verifies storage lifetime and returned order, not independent SEE correctness, legal chess, skipped TT validity, quiet-order correctness or unconsumed storage. Existing H25/H28 and all old31 counters remain unchanged. No extra Board make/unmake, move generation, scoring or counted helper. Diagnostic vector adds local storage only; no position/move dataset is published.

===== END H17_design.txt =====

===== BEGIN H17_cross_review.txt =====
Readonly H17 review PASS before freeze: private separate vector appends existing SEE-fail after TT skip; BadCaptures actual index increments once, full Move fields compare shadow ordinal plus count consistency. No extra SEE/scoring/oldcounterhooks. Reference shares original capture stream/SEE selection, only consumed returns not unconsumed suffix. White flags XOR1 is class-specific private reference fault.

===== END H17_cross_review.txt =====
